BiblicalUsage: Morah is a razor — no razor shall come on the child's head, for he shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb, Samson tells Delilah, and Hannah vows the same over the son she has not yet borne.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the uncut hair is the sign of a life set apart: the razor stays away because the child belongs to God from the first day.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
